events.title: YAZMINDI
events.description: HOTEL BRUNSWICK | THU 10 SEPT Yazmindi’s authentic sound and evocative stories are a far-reaching crowd-favourite. A cornerstone of her musical prowess is her ability to craft authentic stories and evocative soundscapes that build around her swelling harmonies. Yazmindi takes an honest, and sometimes tongue-in-cheek approach to authentically reflect on powerful moments of love, loss, societal pressures, youthful optimism, and determination. Traversing genres, a common theme of empowerment, especially towards young women runs strong and true to Yazmindi’s core values.   FREE ENTRY

events.title: LIVE BABY LIVE | INXS TRIBUTE SHOW
events.description: HURRY NOW to secure your ticket to party with Australia’s most celebrated & exciting tribute to the legendary kings of rock ‘n’ roll: INXS! The critically acclaimed LIVE BABY LIVE: THE INXS TRIBUTE SHOW is THE ultimate live INXS concert experience! Across Australia far and wide, live music lovers are consistently floored and captivated by LIVE BABY LIVE who are recognised as the most authentic & electrifying INXS tribute on the market with an uncanny resemblance to the energy and excitement that once took the whole entire world by storm. FRIDAY 11 SEPT | 6PM AT HOTEL BRUNSWICK It’s time to unleash YOUR devil inside! You will be simply floored and captivated by the performance delivered from six of Australia’s finest musicians as they confidently deliver smash hit after hit over more than two hours in full costume with all the 80s moves, swagger & mojo to keep you begging & screaming out for more. You will feel like you’re witnessing the real thing when you experience LIVE BABY LIVE! TIX ON SALE NOW

events.title: SUB-TRIBE
events.description: SUB-TRIBE LIVE AT HOTEL BRUNSWICK SUNDAY 13 SEPTEMBER | FROM 4PM | FREE EVENT From the roots of Aotearoa (New Zealand) comes SUB-TRIBE — a 7-piece dub-fusion powerhouse delivering heavy bass, glitchy beats and soaring harmonies. Blending blues-soaked dub, chunky skank reggae, jazz-hop and ragga dancehall, SUB-TRIBE take audiences on a genre-hopping journey that keeps dancefloors moving and heads nodding. Known for their high-energy live shows and feel-good vibes, SUB-TRIBE have carved out a sound often described as “Unprecedented Dub-Fusion.” Since forming in 2017 and touring alongside Salmonella Dub, the band has built a strong reputation across Australia and New Zealand, appearing at major festivals including WOMADelaide, Good Love Festival, Kuranda Roots and Island Vibes. With releases spanning deep, rolling dub, soulful lovers rock and bass-driven dancefloor anthems, SUB-TRIBE bring a live show that’s equal parts groove, grit and celebration. w/ support | Free Entry Come skank, sway and get deep in the low end.

events.title: Ben Whiting
events.description: BEN WHITING | Hotel Brunswick | Thursday 17 September 6pm An alluring voice with rock beneath the surface Ben Whiting is a seasoned singer-songwriter whose sound blends sun-soaked reggae grooves, classic rock grit and thoughtful folk songwriting. Raised on a steady diet of The Police and Bob Marley, and shaped by years of jamming, touring and festival stages, Whiting delivers music that feels both familiar and entirely his own. With a “virtually flawless” voice (Faster Louder) at the centre, his live shows move effortlessly between laid-back rhythms, soaring melodies and dynamic rock moments. Having previously played major festivals including Splendour In The Grass and shared stages with artists like Katy Perry, Grinspoon and The Angels, Whiting brings a confident, polished performance that suits both relaxed afternoon sessions and attentive listeners alike. Expect warm grooves, rich vocals and songs that stay with you. Live at Hotel Brunswick 📅 Thursday 17 September 🕑 6:00pm | Free Gig

events.title: MELBOURNE SKA ORCHESTRA
events.description: Monte Loco Rides Again… Melbourne Ska Orchestra are coming to Hotel Brunswick Friday 18th September. Don’t miss out! Hot off the heels of a wild year touring Canada and Australia in 2025, Melbourne Ska Orchestra just can’t keep still. The spaghetti western wagon trail rolls on with the super deluxe edition of their acclaimed album The Ballad of Monte Loco with all the faves, plus a swag of brand-new tracks, blistering live recordings, and honky tonk renditions of MSO staples. It’s braver, meaner and wilder than anything they’ve done before. So saddle up, partner: this here posse is riding into a town near you, and you do not want to miss the showdown. Playing Hotel Brunswick Friday 18th September | Doors 6PM

events.title: TROPIKALIA – BRAZILIAN PARTY
events.description: Tropikalia – A journey Through Brazilian Music Tropikalia brings the best of Brazilian music and good vibes to Hotel Brunswick . Expect a day filled with live music, tropical energy and a dance floor that doesn’t stop. Groove Bahia Band will be playing a mix of Brazilian favourites, while DJ Victor Lopes keeps the party rolling with Brazilian beats. Whether you’re Brazilian or just love great music and a fun atmosphere, Tropikalia is all about bringing people together for a proper celebration. FREE EVENT

events.title: FULL MOON REGGAE PARTY FT. SKYEATER
events.description: FULL MOON REGGAE PARTY | Sunday 20 September, from 4PM | Free Event The beer garden comes alive under the full moon for a soulful reggae celebration! Join us for an arvo of live music, good vibes, and cold drinks, where the rhythm moves your body and the music lifts your spirit. Get ready for SKYEATER — dreamy dub, trip-hop, and soulful pop with reverb-soaked piano, soaring vocals, and reggae-infused beats. Changing the world one song at a time, Sky Eater is here to have fun, spread some joy, and lift your spirit — all at once! So gather your crew, feel the beat, and get on board the full moon reggae celebration!
